issues.reason: Might/Probably attach to an eventuality and no head hedges a single coordinated role filler, so "perhaps" is genuinely unrepresentable here — the instruction set's own directive is to "leave the unrepresentable adverbial out rather than mis-slot it", and the affected atoms sit inside an unasserted seal, so nothing false results.

Events requires "one role atom per participant", and the control-verb rule keeps the matrix verb's own roles while copying the controller into the complement ("urged the clerk to resign") — the object-only-in-the-caused-event restriction is scoped to periphrastic have/get/make/let — so the addressee of "ask him" must carry a role on the ask event.

Comparatives & degree states a comparative "does not entail the positive — taller-than-Y doesn't make X tall", so (Inheritance higher_state_court high) asserts a positive property the sentence never claims.

Lemmatizing "higher" to "high" in the class symbol would collapse the comparative into exactly the positive claim issue 2 correctly rejects; the comparative sections keep the surface adjective as stated, and an attributive comparative with an implicit standard has no licensed encoding, so the surface-faithful opaque symbol is acceptable improvisation in gap territory.

gaps_confirmed: no carrier for a constituent-scoped epistemic hedge on one conjunct of a coordination ("and perhaps U.S. District Court")
attributive comparative with an implicit standard ("a higher state court") — only the predicative "X is ADJ-er than Y" form is covered
a pre-nominal occupational title ("Defense attorney William Rork") — the courtesy-title rule and the appositive rule point different ways and neither is said to govern
coordinated oblique objects ("appeal ... to A and B") — the distributive default is stated for subjects and objects, not for a shared oblique
new_gaps: whether "appeal to <court>" takes Goal or the communication-addressee Recipient is undecided by the role table (the court is both a destination and an addressee)
repair_summary: Added (Recipient sk_ask_1 william_rork) inside the sealed ask bundle so the addressee of "ask him" carries a role on the ask event; removed (Inheritance higher_state_court high), which asserted the positive property a comparative does not entail.
